title: Kafka ISR, acks=all, and Unclean Leader Election
objective: Run a three-broker Kafka cluster, produce with acks=all and min.insync.replicas=2, then reproduce two outcomes of the same broker-death sequence: unbounded produce failures when unclean leader election is off, and a committed offset that disappears when it is on.
whyThisMatters: The SWE Kafka task asks you to explain offsets, groups, and partition-scoped ordering. It does not make you lose a committed message. Until you have a produce that returned success and a consume that never sees that offset, 'acks=all' is a setting, not a durability claim.
evidence: Compose (or equivalent) for a three-broker cluster and git history showing the cluster up before any unclean-election experiment

A captured produce/consume run with unclean.leader.election.enable=false where produces fail or block after ISR shrinks below min.insync.replicas, and no previously-acked offset is missing after recovery

A captured run with unclean.leader.election.enable=true on the same topic configuration family where at least one acked produce offset is absent after the new leader is elected, with broker logs or ISR membership printed
README stating replication.factor, min.insync.replicas, acks, and the exact unclean-election setting for each run
Reflection notes answering the task questions
acceptanceCriteria: The cluster has three brokers; the experiment topic has replication.factor=3 and min.insync.replicas=2; the producer uses acks=all.

The clean-election (or unclean=false) run shows produce errors or a bounded wait once fewer than two in-sync replicas remain, and a later consume of the recovered partition contains every offset the producer marked acked.
The unclean=true run shows at least one offset the producer treated as acked that a consume after failover never returns; the log names that offset.
README scopes every ordering claim to a single partition and never calls the configuration 'exactly-once' or 'no data loss' without naming the unclean-election case that contradicts it.
